notes.title: A Leaderboard Update!
notes.notes:
Hi!

Thanks to everyone buying Lupinball during the Steam winter sale! It's our most successful Steam sale to date, and it will only get better from here.

On our Facebook page, I teased a change coming to Lupinball that will keep the player base engaged, and motivate new players to work their way up.

What's changing with the leaderboard?

Starting 2018, the Lupinball leaderboard will represent wins for that month. At the end of each month, the player with the #1 leaderboard spot will receive glory and fame on all of Lupinball's social media channels, and a new leaderboard for next month will be created.

This update will give all players a chance to be the Lupinball champion, no matter how recent they purchased the game, and will encourage all players to continue playing and work their way up.

What about the current leaderboard?

It will soon be retired, the entries preserved as-is for future Lupinball fans to forever admire! You will be able to view this leaderboard through Steam Community: https://steamcommunity.com//stats/429360/leaderboards/1541715

We have plenty more Lupinball updates after this! Stay tuned and keep awoo'ing.

Michael

notes.title: Lupinball Patch 11/7/2017
notes.notes:
This update adds a new feature: whenever a new lobby is created, the official Lupinball Discord server is notified.

Even if you don't use Discord, this will notify our Lupinball community that an empty lobby is now available. There is no more need for a separate step of logging in to Discord and asking around for opponents.

Of course, nobody likes being a lone wolf, so if you want to join our Discord community and chat with the Lupin-ballers, please do so here: https://discord.me/lupinball

Thanks for the support as we continue to grow our player base and make it easier to find matches!

Michael

notes.title: Lupinball Patch 10/26/2017
notes.notes:
Awoo! This is a bugfix release.


Optimized the netcode a little. This is in response to people saying they had trouble with 4-player matches
Fixed a bug with fireballs in the corners of Fuzzball table and Frostford

notes.title: Lupinball Patch 3
notes.notes:
More fixes, thanks to you all!


REALLY fixed the random-stage issue this time. No more lock-ups when choosing Random
Rewrote the shot-collision behavior. It's much smarter and so shots are less likely to get stuck in odd places
Will now send more data during matches, which will make it far less likely to encounter Disconnects when the connection goes bad
Will be smarter with sending data before each round, which fixes a few mid-game join bugs
Will be smarter about syncing the player order, which fixes some issues with player drop-outs

notes.title: Lupinball Patch 2
notes.notes:
More fixes are here, thanks to your feedback!


The wind in Gailes now follows the SFX volume setting
The game is better behaved when it tries another match after a disconnect
The game is smarter about sending packets during menus in online play
Selecting the "Random" stage sometimes locked up the game, this no longer happens


As usual, you can challenge fellow players, or report bugs to the developers, via Discord. http://discord.me/lupinball

notes.title: Lupinball Patch 1
notes.notes:
We just released the first patch for Lupinball, thanks for all your reports!


Horizontal shots no longer go through seats in Hound Airways
You should no longer get stuck on "The next stage is..." screen without a roulette appearing
Quitting single-player mode causes more stages to appear when going back to single-player mode
Online sync issues


Please continue to report anything you find in the Discord: http://discord.me/lupinball
